condition: Calling groupby().apply() so that it operates on the grouping columns triggers a DeprecationWarning, because pandas 3.0 will leave the grouping columns out of the data passed to the function.
workaround: Select all columns explicitly after groupby, e.g. df.groupby("group")[df.columns].apply(func), or pass include_groups=False and get the group keys back from the result's index.
